summary: Add gh plate pr-packet and plate_pr_packet MCP tool: size-capped JSON evidence packets for PR review feedback, reusing watch probe ETag/since detection and spend-ledger handoff_packet_size (#1364).
migration_impact: New CLI subcommand and review-profile MCP tool. Optional --record-ledger / record_ledger writes spend_interval rows with measured packet bytes.
migration_guidance: 1. Agents call gh plate pr-packet <N> --json or plate_pr_packet instead of re-fetching raw review comments.
2. Pass turns and record_ledger during crew pilots to compare babysit cost (#1327 / #1352).
3. Hosts on default MCP profile get plate_pr_packet via the review profile bundle.
agent_notes: Treat the packet as the single handoff artifact for feedback work; escalate with plate_pr_babysit only when the packet shows unresolved threads or failing checks.
